news.title: CommBank Pararoos fall 1-0 to Brazil in IFCPF World Cup opener
news.lede: The only goal of the match came in the first half, a dangerous cross from the boot of Brazil’s Vinicius Araujo deflecting off the heel of Augustine Murphy and past David Barber in goals. Head Coach Kai Lammert named a mix of experience and youth in the first starting seven of the tournament. David Barber made his 121st appearance in green and gold between the sticks and in the process broke the record to hold the longest male international football career in the world at 26 years and 353 days. A post shared by CommBank Pararoos (@pararoos).

news.title: Moroccan Referees Zoulikha Hermas and Ihssane Ennawajli Join U-17 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Rabat - Morocco's representation at the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup extends beyond the players competing on the pitch, with two Moroccan referees, Zoulikha Hermas and Ihssane Ennawajli, taking part in the global tournament hosted by the Kingdom this October. Their presence highlights the contribution of Moroccan women to international football and reflects the growing visibility of national refereeing talent at major competitions. Hermas will participate as an international referee, a status she has held since 2024. In this role, she belongs to the group of officials entrusted with overseeing matches and ensuring that the laws of the game are applied on the pitch.

news.title: Morocco Women’s Team to Face Venezuela and France in World Cup Warm-Up Friendlies
news.lede: Rabat – Morocco’s women’s national football team will face Venezuela and France in two friendly matches on December 1 and December 5, respectively, as part of their preparations for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup. The Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF) announced the fixtures in a statement published on its official website on Wednesday, confirming that both matches will serve as preparation for the tournament, which will take place in Brazil from June 24 to July 25, 2027. The match against France will take place at the Stade Auguste-Bonal in Sochaux, France, on December 5, with kick-off scheduled for 9:10 p.m. local time. Meanwhile, the FRMF has yet to announce the venue and kick-off time for Morocco's December 1 encounter against Venezuela.

news.title: Pink Football Boots at World Cup 2026: Nike, adidas & PUMA
news.lede: The pink boot trend exploded at the 2026 World Cup: it was obvious from the very first team photo of Mexico vs. South Africa, where almost every player—including those on the bench—was wearing fluorescent pink or electric fuchsia boots. As the tournament progressed, players from other national teams appeared in the same colourways, almost as if the major suppliers had coordinated their efforts. There was a time when football boots came exclusively in black.
